waterRegion.classifier: blue-water core HSV 155-255, saturation >=0.18, B >= 0.85R; 5px conservative pale-blue/contact bridge; 7px non-water standoff

sparkle.classifier: safe water with luminance >=0.58, local 9x9 luminance prominence >=0.12, gradient >=0.04; components 2-96px and <=32px extent

foam.classifier: safe water 7-33px from classified land, luminance >=0.43, saturation <=0.46, gradient >=0.018

crest.classifier: safe-water local luminance gradient >=0.018; alpha proportional to gradient strength

directionField.encoding: RGB = tangent x, tangent y, gradient strength; tangent is sign-normalized to +x

runtime.costBasis: three masked duplicate-canon SVG image passes (sparkle, foam, crest); sparkle switches 30 single-channel frames (76752 encoded bytes total) at 6Hz through SMIL; no canvas, WebGL, or ocean-layer render pass; browser fetch/cache and GPU filter cost require live verification
